title: Sprint 01 - Agent directive contract and registry foundation
description: Define the directive schema, safety boundary, static registry, fixture model, and architecture docs that all later directive compilation depends on.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent directive types, IDs, versioning, severity, audience, kind, source, data, conflict, deprecation, and validation contracts are implemented and documented.
A static master directive registry exists with trusted instruction text and no dynamic instruction interpolation.
Registry validation and golden fixtures prove IDs are unique, active/deprecated states are coherent, and unsafe dynamic text cannot become trusted instruction.
Sprint closeout includes scoped commit evidence or a no-commit reason code.
